notes: First backfill batch: July 2026, reached by search rather than by the feed, which only spans five days. The candidate stories were surfaced by an assisting model with web access; every URL, headline, publication date and quoted span below was re-fetched and checked against the live article before it was written here, and four findings the assisting pass missed inside an article it had already opened were added by that check.

coverage.note: Eight Mission Local articles published between 1 and 31 July 2026 were opened and read in full. The assisting pass reported opening 18 but named only these 8, so the count records what can be audited rather than what was claimed. Ten distinct numbered San Francisco addresses appear across them; nine carry a fact about the building. One article — the 10 July 'Mission Buzz' column — accounts for seven of the nine.
coverage.remaining: July is not exhausted. The pass reached the address-shaped stories that searches surfaced, not the roughly 180 stories Mission Local published in the month; 25–31 July is especially thin. The Buzz column runs regularly and is the densest address source in the paper, so the remaining Buzz columns for July are the first thing to read next.
